description: Precomputed FX reference-price moves for one currency pair around one geopolitical event, by event_id. Context only: not causation or a trading signal. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

as_of.description: Knowledge cutoff with timezone, e.g. 2024-06-30T23:59:59Z; omit for latest.

event_id.description: Event ID from history results: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

pair.description: Uppercase BASE/QUOTE currency pair, e.g. EUR/USD.
